title: Focusable element without an interactive role
user_impact: Focusable element without an interactive role.
technical_impact: Focusable element without an interactive role.
source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard and SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value; WAI-ARIA 1.2 §5.3 (roles of focusable widgets); HTML §6.6.3 tabindex
applicability: Rendered, non-inert elements in the sequential tab order (tabindex >= 0) that are not natively focusable.
expectation:
needs_review once per element that the Tab key reaches but that has no
interactive role (generic, group, paragraph, none and similar): a keyboard
user lands on it, but nothing tells whether or how it can be operated. Not
reported: tabindex="-1" (a script focus target, not a tab stop; the boundary
is 0), a named region with tabindex="0" (the recommended scrollable-region
pattern), elements that are not rendered. A tabindex added by script after
load counts.
